title: 第10章 黑水城遇霜，前路赴黑山
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
黑水城比苏余想象的要破。

    城墙是土夯的，东塌一块西豁一口，城墙根下散落着牲口粪便和不知名的骨头。

    城门口两个守门的穿着半新不旧皮甲坐在门洞子里晒太阳，偶尔有穿得齐整些的商贩经过才伸手拦一下讨几枚铜板。

    苏余站在城门外百步远的一棵枯树下打量这座散修之城。

    他在密道里就已将林霜储物袋中的灵石丹药全部转移到自己怀里，储物袋本身也贴身收好。

    脸上的血痂淤泥在河水里洗了个干净，黑发凌乱垂在眉眼前，皮肤因长期营养不良而苍白，但那双眼睛亮得惊人。

    腰间别着淬毒长刀和卷了刃的寒霜剑，怀里揣着三十多块灵石、几瓶丹药，再加上从宋玉那里得来的符纸——这身家当，在黑水城够他站稳脚跟了。

    苏余迈步朝城门走去。

    两个守门懒汉果然没拦他——其中一个看了他一眼，大概是觉得这年轻人虽穿得破烂但眼神气势不像普通难民，便没有自讨没趣。

    他大摇大摆进了黑水城。

    城里景象比城外更乱。

    土路坑坑洼洼积着臭水，两旁大多是土坯房和木板棚子，偶尔几栋砖瓦房挂着商行镖局招牌。

    街上形形色色——挑担叫卖的小贩，蹲墙角晒太阳的老头，赤上身扛麻袋的苦力，穿绸缎带保镖的商人，更多的是穿着各式袍服的散修，腰间挂着法器脸上带着伤疤。

    苏余走了一刻钟就看见两起斗殴。

    一起是散修为药草当街厮杀，一起是苦力围殴赖账商人。

    没人报官，因为黑水城没有官。

    三大势力——黑虎帮、铁剑门、灵蛇商会——各自划地盘互相牵制维持平衡。

    城南城北穷酸角落三大势力都懒得管，成了散修和难民自发聚集的地方。

    苏余在城南找了处废弃土坯房，推开摇摇欲坠的木门走进去。

    屋里只有一张三条腿木桌和一堆发霉稻草，墙角蹲着只癞皮猫，见有人来喵呜一声从破窗洞窜出去。

    他靠在墙角坐下，把淬毒长刀横在膝上，闭眼检查状态。

    识海中时王碑静静悬浮，碑身比之前大了一圈，多了许多暗金色纹路。

    碑面浮现当前信息：

    【时痕：999】

    【金痕：9（已满）】

    【黑痕：7】

    【天劫豁免：已获得】

    【肉身强化：第一阶段——体质、力量、反应翻倍】

    【时间领域：周身十丈内敌人体感时间流速降低半成】

    【时间回溯：未解锁（需时痕1000点，今夜子时解锁）】

    【时劫：燃九息召唤天劫之力，造成等于时痕总量的真实伤害，无视一切防御。

    使用后金痕清零，天劫豁免失效。

    新增黑痕首次1道，二次2道，三次4道，此后翻倍。】

    时痕差一点破千，今夜子时即可解锁时间回溯——每日一次免死。

    这是他最大的保命底牌。

    天劫豁免已获得，时间掠夺可以使用了。

    他需要找一个合适的目标——炼气后期以上修士，掠夺十年寿元转化百点时痕，凝两道金痕。

    黑痕从七道变八道仍不足九道，暂时安全；金痕从九道变十一道，远超门槛。

    这样就能安全地快速积累时痕。

    不过掠夺会废掉一个人，他得找个罪有应得的目标。

    至于黑山的盘古遗迹——苏玄恶念的记忆告诉他，时之种就封存在遗迹核心的禁制里。

    那是时族先祖留给后人的至宝，融合后可提升时痕积累速度，且使用时间之力时不生黑痕。

    外界各大势力只知道那座遗迹是上古大能留下的洞府，里面藏着能让人脱胎换骨的至宝，却不知道核心禁制里封存的究竟是什么，更不知道开启禁制需要时族血脉。

    他的血脉就是唯一的钥匙。

    这个消息只有他自己知道，连林霜和她师父也只是模模糊糊知道遗迹禁制需要某种“特殊条件”，并不清楚具体是什么。

    他需要进入那座遗迹。

    不是为了至宝，是为了时之种。

    时痕积累越快，金痕凝得越快；不生黑痕意味着时间爆破、时间静止这些技能可以随意使用而不会增加黑痕。

    这才是他真正需要的东西。

    苏余睁开眼，打算出门转转熟悉环境。

    刚站起身就听见外面传来嘈杂叫骂声。

    “给老子站住！”

    “偷了黑虎帮的东西还想跑？”

    苏余从门缝往外看。

    一个瘦弱少年在巷子里狂奔，身后追着四五个膀大腰圆的壮汉。

    少年十五六岁衣衫褴褛面黄肌瘦，怀里死死抱着一个油纸包。

    壮汉们穿着统一黑布短褂，袖口绣着狰狞虎头——黑虎帮的标志。

    少年跑得很快但体力撑不了多久。

    追在最前面的壮汉抓住他后领猛地掼在地上，油纸包摔出散落几块暗红色妖兽肉干。

    “妈的，为了几块肉干跑断老子的腿。”
content_en:
Blackwater City was more dilapidated than Su Yu imagined.

    The city wall was made of rammed earth, with a piece broken in the east and a crack in the west. Animal dung and unknown bones were scattered under the base of the wall.

    Two gatekeepers at the city gate were sitting in the doorway basking in the sun, wearing half-new leather armor. Occasionally, a better-dressed merchant would pass by and they would reach out to stop him and ask for a few coins.

    Su Yu stood under a dead tree a hundred steps away from the city gate and looked at this city of casual cultivators.

    He had already transferred all the spiritual stone pills in Lin Shuang's storage bag to his arms in the secret passage, and the storage bag itself was also stored close to his body.

    The blood scabs and mud on his face were washed away in the river water. His black hair was messy and hung in front of his eyebrows. His skin was pale due to long-term malnutrition, but his eyes were astonishingly bright.

    At his waist was a poison-quenching long sword and a curled frost sword, and in his arms he carried more than thirty spiritual stones, several bottles of elixirs, and the talismans he got from Song Yu - this wealth was enough for him to gain a foothold in Blackwater City.

    Su Yu walked toward the city gate.

    As expected, the two lazy gatekeepers did not stop him - one of them glanced at him, probably thinking that although the young man was dressed in rags, his eyes did not look like ordinary refugees, so he did not ask for trouble.

    He swaggered into Blackwater City.

    The scene in the city is more chaotic than outside the city.

    The dirt road is filled with potholes and stinking water. Most of them are adobe houses and wooden sheds on both sides. Occasionally, a few brick houses have the signs of the Trading Company and Escort Bureau.

    There are all kinds of people on the street - hawkers carrying burdens to sell goods, old men squatting in the corners to bask in the sun, bare-chested coolies carrying sacks, businessmen wearing silk ribbons with bodyguards, and more casual cultivators wearing various robes, with magic weapons hanging on their waists and scars on their faces.

    Su Yu saw two fights within a quarter of an hour after walking.

    At one time, casual cultivators were fighting in the street for medicinal herbs, and at the other time, coolies were beating up deadbeat merchants.

    No one reported to the police because there were no officials in Blackwater City.

    The three major forces - the Black Tiger Gang, the Iron Sword Sect, and the Spirit Snake Chamber of Commerce - each have their own territories to contain each other to maintain balance.

    The three major forces in the poor corners of the south and north of the city didn't bother to take care of it, and it became a place where casual cultivators and refugees gathered spontaneously.

    Su Yu found an abandoned adobe house in the south of the city, pushed open the shaky wooden door and walked in.

    There was only a three-legged wooden table and a pile of moldy straw in the room. A mangy cat squatted in the corner. When someone came, it meowed and ran out of the broken window.

    He sat down against the corner, put the poison-quenching knife across his knees, and closed his eyes to check his status.

    The King's Monument was floating quietly in the sea of ​​consciousness. The body of the Monument was larger than before, with many more dark golden lines.

    Current information appears on the monument:

    【Time mark: 999】

    [Gold marks: 9 (full)]

    [Black marks: 7]

    [Heavenly Tribulation Exemption: Obtained]

    [Physical Strengthening: The First Stage—Physique, Strength, and Reactions Doubled]

    [Time Domain: The physical sense of time flow rate of enemies within ten feet of the body is reduced by half]

    [Time backtracking: not unlocked (requires 1000 time trace points, unlocked at midnight tonight)]

    [Time Tribulation: Burn Nine Breaths to summon the power of Heavenly Tribulation, causing real damage equal to the total amount of time traces, ignoring all defenses.

    After use, the gold traces will be cleared and the immunity from heavenly tribulation will be invalid.

    The number of new black marks is 1 for the first time, 2 for the second time, 4 for the third time, and doubled thereafter. 】

    The time mark is almost over a thousand, and you can unlock time rewind at midnight tonight - avoid death once a day.

    This is his biggest life-saving trump card.

    The Catastrophe immunity has been obtained and Time Plunder is ready for use.

    He needs to find a suitable target - a monk in the late stage of Qi refining and above, plunder ten years of life, transform it into a hundred time marks, and condense two golden marks.

    The black marks changed from seven to eight, still less than nine, which was temporarily safe; the gold marks changed from nine to eleven, far beyond the threshold.

    This allows time marks to be accumulated quickly and safely.

    But plunder will destroy a person, and he has to find a deserving target.

    As for the Pangu ruins in Black Mountain - Su Xuan's evil memory told him that the Seed of Time was sealed in the ban at the core of the ruins.

    It is a treasure left by the ancestors of the Time clan to future generations. After fusion, it can increase the speed of accumulation of time marks, and no black marks will be produced when using the power of time.

    The major forces in the outside world only know that the ruins are caves left by ancient powers, and that they contain treasures that can transform people. However, they do not know what is sealed in the core restriction, nor do they know that the blood of the Time clan is needed to open the restriction.

    His bloodline is the only key.

    Only he knew this news. Even Lin Shuang and her master only vaguely knew that the ban on ruins required some "special conditions", but they didn't know what they were.

    He needed to enter the ruins.

    Not for the treasure, but for the seeds of time.

    The faster the accumulation of time marks, the faster the golden marks will condense; no black marks will be generated, which means that skills such as time blast and time still can be used at will without increasing black marks.

    This is what he really needs.

    Su Yu opened his eyes and planned to go out and familiarize himself with the environment.

    As soon as he stood up, he heard loud shouts and curses coming from outside.

    "Stop for me!"

    "You stole something from the Black Tiger Gang and you still want to run away?"

    Su Yu looked out from the crack in the door.

    A thin young man ran wildly in the alley, chased by four or five muscular men with round waists.

    The boy was about fifteen or sixteen years old, with ragged clothes, yellow face and skinny muscles. He was holding an oil paper bag tightly in his arms.

    The strong men wore uniform short black cloth jackets with ferocious tiger heads embroidered on the cuffs - the symbol of the Black Tiger Gang.

    The boy ran very fast but his physical strength could not last long.

    The strong man who was chasing him at the front grabbed him by the back of his collar and slammed him to the ground. A few pieces of dark red monster meat jerky fell out of the oil paper bag.

    "Damn it, you broke my legs for a few pieces of dried meat."
title_en: Chapter 10 Blackwater City encounters frost, the road ahead is to Black Mountain
